mapper.sql: id, account, password_hash, name, college, phone, role, status, blocked, must_change_password, auth_version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (account, password_hash, name, college, phone, role, status, blocked, must_change_password, auth_version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{account}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{college}, #{phone}, #{role}, #{status}, #{blocked}, #{mustChangePassword}, #{authVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET auth_version = auth_version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE role = #{role}
